name: ChristianSteven
summary: Report automation for Power BI, SSRS, Tableau and Crystal Reports: schedule, personalise and deliver reports by email, folders or cloud storage, with a 30-day free trial.
best_for: IT and reporting teams that already run Power BI, SSRS, Tableau or Crystal Reports and need scheduled, personalised report delivery by email, folders or other destinations
skip_if: you only need simple report emails that built-in Power BI subscriptions handle, you want a published price for every plan, or you need a tool you can buy online without talking to sales
honest_knock: Only the smallest PBRS tier has a public price, and that one is labelled a special offer with terms. Prices for Tableau, Crystal Reports and the dashboard product were not on the pages we read, so the full cost needs a quote.

pricing.entry_price_terms: PBRS up to 100 peak outputs · per month, PBRS Option 1, up to 100 peak outputs and 1 installation, shown as a special offer with terms and conditions
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-12 on go.christiansteven.com/pbrs-pricing-purchase, US dollars) ChristianSteven sells four report-automation products: PBRS for Power BI and SSRS, ATRS for Tableau, CRD for Crystal Reports and IntelliFront BI. We read the PBRS pricing page. It prices PBRS two ways. Option 1 limits peak outputs on one installation: up to 100 peak outputs costs $249.59 a month, shown as a special offer with terms and conditions, while the 200 and 1000 output tiers say Talk to Sales. Option 2 gives unlimited outputs on 1 installation, 2 installations or unlimited installations, all through sales. Every PBRS plan lists 10 concurrent Web App users (unlimited on the unlimited-installation plan), unlimited Server App users, unlimited API access, and 1 year of technical support and software updates. The page says annual subscriptions can be paid online or invoiced on NET 30 terms, and month-to-month subscriptions need automated online payment. A formal quote is available before purchase. The homepage offers a 30-day free trial with no licence, account or credit card. We did not read the ATRS, CRD or IntelliFront BI prices.

schema_offer.description: PBRS up to 100 peak outputs, PBRS Option 1, up to 100 peak outputs and 1 installation, shown as a special offer with terms and conditions; every larger PBRS plan says Talk to Sales; ATRS, CRD and IntelliFront BI prices not read. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-12.
